beats.text: Be honest: how many years are there between you and your partner?
Because the bigger the gap, the bigger the divorce risk!
Same survey, over three thousand married Americans. Compared to couples the same age:
One year apart? Three percent more likely to divorce.
Five years? Eighteen percent! And ten years?
So love has no age. But statistics do!

sources: Francis-Tan & Mialon (2015), "'A Diamond is Forever' and Other Fairy Tales: The Relationship between Wedding Expenses and Marriage Duration", Economic Inquiry (working paper 2014, Emory University). Online survey of ~3,000+ ever-married US adults (KSL: 3,370). Correlational (hazard of divorce).
Age difference vs same-aged couples: 1 year -> ~3% more likely to divorce; 5 years -> ~18%; 10 years -> ~39%. Via Megan Garber, The Atlantic (2014), as reported by Great Bend Tribune.
